en: Black‑and‑white view of a large hilltop castle or palace complex rising above a river. The multi‑storey structure has steep gabled roofs, many small rectangular windows, and a tall, slender spire with an onion‑shaped top, characteristic of Central European baroque influence. Below the main complex are smaller houses with pitched roofs, terraces, and abundant trees and gardens descending to the riverbank in the foreground. There is no visible printed title or caption on the image side.
